name: lyrics-tracer-raycast-extension
title: Lyrics Tracer
description: Search songs and trace lyrics line by line with quick copy actions.
author: agarfuin

commands.name: trace-lyrics
commands.title: Trace Lyrics
commands.description: Load lyrics from a song name argument and copy lyric lines while tracing.

preferences.name: defaultCopyMode
preferences.title: Default Copy Style
preferences.description: Select the copy format used by Enter in the lyrics list.

preferences.name: showInlineTranslation
preferences.title: Inline Translation
preferences.label: Show English translation for non-English songs
preferences.description: Detects the song's main language and shows an English translation beside each line. Uses the MyMemory daily quota.

preferences.name: translationContactEmail
preferences.title: Translation Contact Email
preferences.description: Optional email passed to MyMemory to raise the free daily quota from 5,000 to 50,000 characters.

commands.name: play-song
commands.title: Play Song
commands.description: Search a song and start playing it in the Spotify desktop app, or open it in YouTube Music.

preferences.name: spotifyClientId
preferences.title: Spotify Client ID
preferences.description: Client ID of your own Spotify app. Register the redirect URI https://raycast.com/redirect?packageName=Extension. No client secret is needed or stored.

preferences.name: closeAfterPlay
preferences.title: Window Behavior
preferences.label: Close Raycast after starting playback
preferences.description: Closes the Raycast window and shows a HUD once playback starts.

scripts.prepublishOnly: echo "Use npm run publish to publish this extension to the Raycast Store." && exit 1
